items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I told him I had to see my manager because I didn't know what to charge or what to do, because I thought he was just a friend of mine so he saw my manager and my manager charged him $400 a lesson

ctx.x: Mr. Bubbles, now I'd like you to tell me a little about your teaching Fred Astaire.

Yeah, Fred Astaire wanted to learn a few steps going along with the dancing he does and I told him I had to see my manager because I didn't know what to charge or what to do, because I thought he was just a friend of mine so he saw my manager and my manager charged him $400 a lesson, $400 an hour, you know.
